en: A vintage black-and-white postcard featuring a cobblestone street in a mountain village, with a prominent church with a tall spire in the center. The street is lined with old buildings and a few people are visible. There is a full moon or bright light in the sky. The right half of the postcard contains handwritten text in a Slavic language, possibly Czech, and the red printed word 'Predazzo' at the top.
